emotion_text: I read the offer twice and walked around the kitchen because I could not sit down.
neutral_text: I read the offer and then sat down to look at the start date.

emotion_text: I saw them at the airport barrier and we both started talking at once.
neutral_text: I met them at the airport barrier and we walked to the train.

emotion_text: The test finally went green, and I leaned back and laughed at the line on the screen.

neutral_text: From the ridge I sat on the rock and noted the time of sunrise.

neutral_text: I opened the door and they came into the hallway with their bag.

neutral_text: I took the loaf out of the oven and set it on the board to cool.

neutral_text: I picked the first ripe tomato and brought it inside to the kitchen counter.

emotion_text: A song I know by heart came on, and I turned it up and sang the chorus while the kettle boiled.
neutral_text: A song I know by heart came on while the kettle boiled, and I left it at the usual volume.

neutral_text: Snow started falling, and I looked out of the window at the street.

emotion_text: The dog met me at the door with its whole body moving, and I knelt down on the mat.
neutral_text: The dog met me at the door, and I hung up my coat and walked into the kitchen.

emotion_text: I saved the file I had been writing for weeks, closed it, and went out for a walk I did not need to take.
neutral_text: I saved the file I had been writing for weeks, closed it, and looked at the rest of the afternoon.
